Explicit gaps: fake-JM host only, no GPU/pixels/hardware; 4-target MRT/per-target blends and TLS are transport/oracle tests; path_blit true-MRT attachment2 fetch has no snapshot transport and is inert in backboardd, nil/error otherwise; runtime-scoped inert is host seam only, no daemon/device test; C3 harness uses minimal fake ObjC objects; receipt compiler older than current; compute mips>1/>16layers/atomics/exact sampler/render specialized compiler execution remain cross-owner; no phone/commit/native/publish.
